title: Penalties for unlicensed acts.
bodyText: Any person or business organization that violates the provisions of section 460J-6 shall not be fined less than $5,000.
bodyHtml: §460J-27  Penalties for unlicensed acts.  Any person or business organization that violates the provisions of section 460J-6 shall not be fined less than $5,000. [L 1972, c 134, pt of §1; am L 1986, c 126, §6]
